---
name: "⚡️ Enhancement"
about: "Suggest an improvement to an existing feature"
title: "[ENHANCEMENT] "
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""
---

### Current Behavior / Motivation

A description of the current behavior, limitations, or why this improvement is needed.

_e.g. Currently, the search begins from the top of the terminal, causing the view to jump away from the current scroll position._

### Proposed Improvement

A clear and concise description of the suggested enhancement and how it improves the user experience.

_e.g. Start the search from the current scroll position (viewport) so users can find matches near their current view._

### Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or links to related issues here.

_e.g. Related to issue #155._
